title: Snail Passing Lane
premise: A snail with a spoiler is using the passing lane. The cars behind it have cobwebs. One driver is a skeleton still honking.
visual: Three-lane highway, forced perspective. Tiny racing snail, red stripe, helmet, spoiler, occupying the left lane on a trail of slime. Traffic packed behind: cobwebs between bumpers, a bird nest on a hood, a skeleton in a convertible still pressing the horn. The snail looks thrilled. Checkered flag far ahead, unused.
characterLean: Cutaway after anyone is 'just going to pass them.' The skeleton has been here since Episode 3 and is still on the clock.
